how: We read the website of every Denver wedding videographer listed on Lazo (105 listings, 84 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: national studios with a Denver landing page, a Tennessee studio, a corporate production house, and photographers who were listed under video. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you record vows and toasts cleanly outdoors? Foothills and mountain ceremonies are windy, so ask about lapel mics and a feed from the DJ's board.
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
What is the coverage cap, and what does overtime cost if the reception runs late?

picks.name: Damian Media Videography
picks.blurb: Damian and Kyla are a filmmaking duo based in Colorado and Chicago with more than ten years in video production, and they cap themselves at three weddings a month to protect the quality of each film. Deliverables start with a two-to-three-minute film of the biggest moments and emotion of the day.

picks.name: Authentic Moments Media
picks.blurb: Started by Zac and Sean, two Colorado wedding creatives, Authentic Moments is a Fort Collins team of photographers, videographers, editors and client support working as one unit. Bundled pricing for couples who want one connected team and a single plan for photo and video.

picks.name: Wild Opal Photo + Film
picks.blurb: Super 8 wedding films alongside documentary photography and 35mm stills, from a Greenwood Village studio that documents weddings the way they felt rather than the way they looked. For couples who want the nostalgic look of real film in motion.

picks.name: Veiled Rose Films Wedding Videography
picks.blurb: Brian Alan runs Veiled Rose Films as a boutique Denver videography company, drawing on more than a decade in the Denver film scene and hundreds of weddings filmed across Colorado and the country. The site publishes pricing and collections and lists partner venues where extra inclusions apply.

picks.name: Foster Creative | Elopement & Intimate Wedding Photography & Videography
picks.blurb: The Fosters film and photograph elopements and intimate weddings across Colorado and the Western United States, with desert, mountain and beach videography and international availability. They pitch themselves as adventure guides who help plan the day, not just document it, out of Aurora.

picks.name: Castlehouse Videography
picks.blurb: A Boulder photo and video duo, partners in life and art, who help couples craft elopements and then film them: the quiet, the laughter, the wind on the ridge. Castlehouse's elopement packages come with planning support, and the site walks through what eloping actually involves.

picks.name: Rocky Mountain Films
picks.blurb: Ben has been a professional videographer since 2017 and has specialized in weddings since 2019, with more than 200 filmed. He handles each couple himself from first contact to delivery, and the site explains the longer-form documentary film option alongside the highlight. Based in Denver.

picks.name: RFD Productions | Colorado Wedding Videographer
picks.blurb: Jeremy McDaniel is a Loveland wedding and event videographer with a soft spot for elopements and a cinematic, documentary style. A Midwesterner who moved to the mountains after college, he films destination weddings as well as corporate and brand work.

picks.name: Lupher Arts Wedding Motion Pictures
picks.blurb: A family-owned Littleton studio that describes itself as an Emmy award winning Denver wedding videographer with more than 15 years of weddings behind it. Lupher Arts builds a personalized plan before the day and edits an extended cinematic highlight of the whole wedding.

picks.name: ABC Music Video and Photography
picks.blurb: ABC has been a Denver wedding DJ, video and photography company since 1985, with over 20 years of wedding photography on top, and offers discounts for bundling its services. A Littleton outfit that says the area's venues already know its crews.

picks.name: Mile High Club Productions
picks.blurb: Films shot in 4K by a Lakewood videographer whose background spans storytelling, branding and high-pressure live events. Mile High Club Productions has documented intimate elopements, large celebrations and fashion shows, and makes the point that weddings do not pause for a second take.
